comment: AdcSR (Chen, Li, Wu, Zhang, Chen, Zhang, Zhang; CVPR 2025, 'Adversarial Diffusion Compression for Real-World Image Super-Resolution'), the authors' own Hugging Face repository: the x4 network weights (net_params_200.pkl, stage 2), the channel-pruned VAE decoder it is assembled with (weight/pretrained/halfDecoder.ckpt, stage 1), and the inference code test.py runs (model.py, forward.py). SHA-256 of every file the harness reads, pinned 2026-11-06; the two checkpoints equal the Hub's LFS hashes at this revision. The repository's LICENSE (Apache-2.0) covers the code. The weights are derivatives of stabilityai/stable-diffusion-2-1-base (the U-Net is SD 2.1 base's, channel-pruned to 0.75 width by model.py's halve_channels and adversarially distilled from OSEDiff, itself a LoRA on SD 2.1 base; the decoder is a half-width VAE decoder trained to decode SD 2.1's latents; see lineage), so they carry SD 2.1 base's CreativeML Open RAIL++-M License and its use-based restrictions (Attachment A), which paragraph 5 requires every redistribution to pass on.

upstreamCode.comment: The GitHub repository's head (2025-04-05). LICENSE, model.py, forward.py and test.py there are byte-identical to the Hugging Face revision's (same SHA-256), so the harness reads them from the Hugging Face snapshot; this records the cross-check.

base.comment: stabilityai/stable-diffusion-2-1-base is no longer on the Hub (404 since Stability AI withdrew its SD 2.x repositories). test.py reads only its U-Net architecture from it: every U-Net weight it loads is overwritten by net_params_200.pkl (a strict load), so the harness builds the U-Net from the config alone, with no SD 2.1 weights. The config comes from Manojb/stable-diffusion-2-1-base, the mirror OSEDiff's README names as its 'SD21 Base' (its unet/config.json has the same git blob as sd2-community/stable-diffusion-2-1-base's, 0fa07f924dabbf7517dc62af845cd31573bc09e3); the strict load of net_params_200.pkl checks every shape it implies. The license text (LICENSE-MODEL, CreativeML Open RAIL++-M, dated November 24, 2022) is from STHCD/stable-diffusion-2-1-base, a mirror of the original repository; inspiritcmteam/stable-diffusion-2-1-base's copy is byte-identical, and sd2-community/stable-diffusion-2's differs only in whitespace and a leading 'Copyright (c) 2022 Stability AI and contributors' line.

lineage.role: the U-Net's architecture and initialization (test.py builds Net from pipe.unet; halve_channels keeps each weight's first 0.75 of channels); the latent space the decoder decodes
lineage.measured: net_params_200.pkl's U-Net tensors against the same 0.75 slices of SD 2.1 base's U-Net (Manojb mirror, unet/diffusion_pytorch_model.fp16.safetensors, LFS 28ec9cf3...): median cosine 0.939 over 523 tensors (0.06 to 0.9995): trained from SD 2.1 base, not from scratch. halfDecoder.ckpt's decoder is not a slice of SD's (cosine ~0 per tensor); its encoder, quant_conv and post_quant_conv equal SD 2.1 base's VAE (cosine 1.0; that VAE's fp16 file has the same LFS hash, 3e4c0899..., as stabilityai/sd-turbo's). Only the decoder half is loaded.
